title_zh: 区分学院收件通知与录取通知

scenario.label_zh: 区分申请收件与录取并索取确认
scenario.goal_zh: 核对邮件只证明申请已收到，确认录取另行通知并索取预计决定时间

context_zh: 虚构艺术学院申请咨询，不代表真实录取流程。
author: author-phase09-c

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: I received a message from the academy saying my application is complete. Is that an acceptance letter?

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: No. It confirms we've received the required documents. The admission decision comes in a separate message.

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: Then I shouldn't make travel plans yet.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: That's right. This message doesn't offer you a place.

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: Can you tell me when decisions are expected? I can't find a date in it.

sentences.speaker: Mina
sentences.text: I'll ask the admissions team to send you the current timetable.

sentences.speaker: Rowan
sentences.text: Thank you. I'll wait for that and the actual decision before arranging the journey.
